messages:
Maya: Postmortem is up. Two customer-facing items to assign: (A) 48h executive summary for affected customers, (B) status page copy + brief incident card, and (C) an RCA access playbook (when/how we share deeper artifacts). Can we pick owners now?
Owen: I can take the status page + incident card. I'll keep it short and factual. ETA 4h.
Ravi: I'll own the 48h exec summary. Will do a plain-language version for customers and a one-paragraph exec blurb for CSMs. ETA 36h.
Sofia: Legal here. For RCA access playbook: we need 1) sharing tiers (public summary / sanitized RCA / full RCA), 2) redaction checklist, 3) approval flow, and 4) SLA for requests. I can draft the playbook but need infra input on which artifacts are exportable. ETA 72h.
incident-bot: Created ACTION-4902 and linked to postmortem: https://go/reports/ACTION-4902
Maya: Proposed owners -> Owen=statuspage (ETA +4h), Ravi=48h summary (ETA +36h), Sofia=RCA-playbook (ETA +72h). Also: infra team needs an action for recurring-pattern detection on cache evictions. Should we create ACTION-4903?
Owen: Status page draft (v0):
```
Partial degradation in request throughput for a subset of customers in APAC between 11:20-11:58 UTC. Failover restored service at 11:58 UTC. We are implementing safeguards to prevent similar cache eviction spikes.
```
Owen: Keeping it neutral; also adding a short contact line: support@redwood.ai and an "affected customers will receive a direct summary" note.
Ravi: 48h summary outline: tl;dr, who affected, timeline, immediate mitigation, root cause (high-level), what we're doing next, how to request full RCA, and expected review SLA (7 business days). Will add CSM note.
Sofia: For playbook: default = public incident card + status page. Sanitized RCA = redacted technical RCA (PII removed, internal IPs removed, no unredacted logs). Full RCA only on request + review + redaction + exec approval, and if necessary NDA. Draft will include redaction checklist.
Maya: Good. On recurring pattern: infra reported 5 similar evictions in 8 weeks. Let's tag incident as "eviction-series" and create a follow-up ACTION-4903 for pattern review and detection thresholds. Owner: infra-ops (TBD). ETA: 3w for detection changes, 6w for hard mitigation.
incident-bot: ACTION-4902 updated -> owners assigned: Owen, Ravi, Sofia. ACTION-4903 created -> owner: infra-ops (unassigned).
Owen: Quick question: status page - do we mention exact internal cause or keep causal language high-level?
Sofia: Recommend high-level causal language on public channels. Provide more specifics in sanitized RCA. Only share low-level technical artifacts to customers with NDAs and a clear redaction pass.
Ravi: I'll include the contact + request flow in the 48h summary: support@redwood.ai and a short form link (internal link): https://go/request-rca. SLA: 7 business days for review; expedited requests case-by-case.
Maya: Scheduling a 25-min sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC to review drafts and approve owners. Please upload drafts to ACTION-4902 before the sync.
Owen: Posting statuspage draft and incident card to ACTION-4902 now.
Sofia: I'll attach a skeleton redaction checklist and the playbook template to ACTION-4902 within 48h for early review.
Ravi: Uploading 48h draft by 09:30 UTC tomorrow.
Maya: Final EOD checklist: ACTION-4902 has owners + ETAs, status page posted (Owen), 48h draft in tracker (Ravi), RCA-playbook WIP (Sofia). If anything slips, DM me.
incident-bot: ACTION-4902 status -> owners set; due dates recorded.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Note to ops: please ensure affected customers list is exported to ACTION-4902 so we can send direct summaries.
Owen: Will request the export and attach it.
Sofia: One legal note for the playbook: include a short template clause for NDAs and a minimal set of allowed attachments. I'll add that.
Maya: Closing thread for now; will reopen if new issues. :white_check_mark:
